rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Agent Security provides runtime security checks for AI agents including prompt injection detection, secret scanning, and permission auditing. It helps developers identify and mitigate common security vulnerabilities in agent-driven workflows before they reach production. The server installs as an npm package and runs locally alongside other MCP tools.
